lesson: Both trades failed due to over-reliance on mean-reversion indicators (RSI/Bollinger) during strong momentum phases, leading to premature entries against the prevailing trend. The system is currently misinterpreting exhaustion signals as structural reversals, ignoring the strength of the underlying trend.
adjustment: Require a confirmed Wyckoff 'Spring' or 'Upthrust' pattern on the 1h timeframe before entering against the trend, rather than relying solely on oscillator extremes.
methodology_flag: Trust RSI/Bollinger mean-reversion signals LESS on AVAXUSDT during high-volatility regimes.
